units.source_text: 远处的重山叠峦迷迷蒙蒙地罩上了一层柔和的乳白色。

en.t: The distant layers of mountains were veiled in a soft, milky white haze.

units.source_text: 岛村想起按摩女的话就说，在这里练也行。

en.t: Remembering what the masseuse had said, Shimamura said she could practice here too.

units.source_text: 驹子听后，站起来往家里挂电话，叫家里人把长歌\[长歌是一种伴三弦、笛子演唱的歌曲，常与歌舞伎、舞蹈等配合演出。\]的本子连同替换的衣裳一起拿来。

en.t: After hearing this, Komako stood up and telephoned home, asking them to bring her nagauta book along with a change of clothes.
